Enrich person.name: Charles McLeod
Enrich person.title: Chief Financial Officer, New York
Enrich person.summary:
CFO and energy executive with more than 20 years of international experience leading finance, strategy, transformation and business performance across regulated utilities, retail energy, energy services and upstream operations.

Currently CFO for National Grid's New York Transmission & Distribution business, serving 4.2 million customers and supporting over $23 billion of planned infrastructure investment over the next five years to modernize the network, improve reliability and advance the energy transition.

Prior to National Grid, I held a number of senior leadership roles with Centrica plc, including CFO of British Gas Energy, the UK's largest retail energy supplier, CFO of British Gas Services & Insurance, CFO of Centrica Energy Canada, and Director of Group Strategy.

Above all, I believe leadership is about building capable teams, creating clarity in complex environments and delivering long-term value for customers and stakeholders.
Enrich person.headline: Chief Financial Officer, New York, National Grid

Enrich person.name: Douglas Stein
Enrich person.title: Chief Financial Officer, New England
Enrich person.summary: Motivated, versatile, and well-respected finance executive with more than twenty years of experience directing financial operations for multi-billion-dollar portfolios of assets for a large multinational company.  Proven financial analysis and operations acuity, developing systems and processes to effectively integrate reporting, budgeting, and strategic planning in order to optimize value, maximize cash flow and minimize risk and cost.  Led large teams in a broad spectrum of functions including finance, accounting, budgeting, performance control, audit, credit, tax, operations, data analytics, M&A and human resources.  Deep passion for building successful teams and shaping culture so that each unique organization is set up to achieve its mission and vision.  Effective communicator and dynamic decision-maker, driven by solid analytical and leadership skills.
